newsitem.title: FRANCE: Babysitter held after infant's hands, feet cut off.
newsitem.headline: Babysitter held after infant's hands, feet cut off.

text.p: A one-year-old baby identified only as Sabrina died overnight in a Paris hospital after her babysitter allegedly amputated the tiny infant's hands and feet, police and hospital officials said on Friday.
The babysitter, a Cameroonian woman aged 25 whose name was not disclosed, was in custody in the Paris suburb of Bobigny after confessing to the amputations, a police official said.
The young woman has offered no explanation. Nor has she said what she had done with the feet and hands, cut from the baby's body with a knife, the official said.

The incident took place on Thursday in the Paris suburb of Bagnolet, police said. Sabrina's mother left the baby with the young woman while she ran some errands. Upon her return, she found the badly bleeding baby alone in the apartment.
Based on the mother's description, police later found the woman nearby and took her into custody for questioning.
